material.learn: Different kinds of support at one price (a swing low, an average, a retracement) make a stronger floor than any one alone.

material.head: Weekly: a deep wave 4
material.text: Waves 1 to 3 up from Sep 17, 2025 to May 6 (+111%; wave 3 is 3.8 times wave 1). The pullback is under the 0.382–0.5 zone of wave 3 (+11% to +3.1%), with the 50-week average and the Aug 31 low in the same place. The count is wrong on a close under the wave-1 high (−18%): wave 4 never overlaps wave 1.
material.learn: Wave 4 usually pulls back to the 0.382–0.5 retracement of wave 3 and holds above wave 1's top; the buy comes when price turns up there.

material.head: A hammer at a support area
material.text: On Nov 27 it dipped and closed near its high, leaving a long lower wick: buyers rejected the lows after a decline.
material.learn: A dip the close bought back: a small body over a tall lower shadow.

material.head: Next support −8.5% below
material.text: The next floor under it is −8.5% below (1.4 ATR): the Oct 23 low, the Mar 31 low and the Mar 9 low.
material.learn: A price where buyers stepped in before.
